svg.title: Figure19 Failure Handling and Recovery Model
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0 Failure Handling and Recovery Model
svg.text: Figure19 Failure Handling and Recovery Model
Failure Boundaries → Recovery Decision → Retry / Compensation / Reconciliation
Authorization Request → Authorization Evaluation → Authorization Decision
Service Enforcement → Service Action → Consumption Transaction
A failure at one boundary SHALL NOT be interpreted as successful completion of the next boundary.
Select recovery action according to failure classification
Reconciliation when independent state may differ
Final failure when recovery is not possible
New Authorization Request → New Evaluation → New Decision
Previous decision SHALL NOT be assumed valid
Authorization = Allow → Service Enforcement → Discount Applied
Consumption Persistence Failure → Retry with Same Transaction ID
Persistent failure → Recovery State → Reconciliation Required
